 Meter Rates and Time Limits ** NEW RATES EFFECTIVE 1/1/2025

  • Parking Meters ** Max 2 Hour Parking in all Zones
    • Cash Payments: 25 cents per 15 minutes. Meters accept all coin types
    • Credit Card Payments: $1.00 per hour.  Min. 1 hour parking.
      • Visa, Discover and Mastercard accepted.  A $1.00 convenience fee is added to all credit card transactions.
      • My Parking Receipt is a convenient website that allows customers to view, download, and print their parking receipts for parking sessions paid by credit card at any IPS meter.
  • Pay Stations:
    • Cash Payments: 25 cents per 15 minutes. Meters accept all coin types
    • Credit Card Payments: $1.00 per hour.  Min. 1 hour parking.
      • Visa, Discover and Mastercard accepted.  A $1.00 convenience fee is added to all credit card transactions.
      • My Parking Receipt is a convenient website that allows customers to view, download, and print their parking receipts for parking sessions paid by credit card at any IPS meter.

  • Time limits and hours of enforcement for parking meters are posted on signs in every metered area, as well as on each parking meter.

Municipal Parking Lot Permits

Permits may be applied for at the office of the Department of Public Works located on the 2nd Floor of Town Hall. All permits must be displayed visibly in the front windshield.

  •  Download: Municipal Parking Application

   Application and Payment must be returned to the Department of Public Works via mail or drop box.   

 Monthly fees for parking lot permits are as follows:  ** NEW FEES EFFECTIVE 1/1/2025

Permit TypeHours ValidMonthly Fee
AM Permit8:00am - 8:00pm$75.00
PM Permit8:00pm - 8:00am$65.00
24 Hour Permit24 Hours$125.00
Senior Citizen (Nutley Senior Manor)24 Hours$50.00
Student8:00am - 4:00pm$50.00
  • Permits may be paid for: Monthly, Quarterly or Annually
  • Payment is due every month. Non-payment will result in loss of parking privileges.

Malfunctioning Parking Meters

Please stay with meter and immediately report malfunctioning meters to the Department of Public Works at 973-284-4984. When calling, please indicate the meter ID number (e.g., F-149) located on the parking meter screen.

Parking Ticket Payments

Parking tickets can be paid in person at:

Municipal Court Violations Bureau 
Public Safety Building, 2nd Floor
228 Chestnut Street
Hours of Operation:  Monday thru Friday, 8:00am - 4:00pm

Parking tickets can also be paid online at  www.NJMCDirect.com  .
